subject: Model training exclusion and prompt/response retention — Acme Health audit
messages:
From: Paula Gomez <paula.gomez@acme-health.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Security Team <sec-team@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions re: prompt retention and training (Acme DPIA questionnaire)

Hi Laura,

We're working through the DPIA and Acme's legal team has flagged a few outstanding items around AI/LLM data handling that we need to close for our security review:

1) Does Redwood use customer prompts or model outputs (prompt/response pairs) to train or improve any shared models? If yes, what safeguards and anonymization/pseudonymization steps are applied?

2) If Acme wants to exclude our prompts/responses from any training corpora, what is the process and the expected timeline for that exclusion? Is there a formal opt-out/contract amendment?

3) What is the default retention period for prompt/response logs in your hosted offering? Where are these logs stored and how are they encrypted and access-controlled?

4) We are a HIPAA-covered entity. Please confirm whether Redwood has contractual BAAs and whether hosted logs can be configured to be covered by a BAA.

I've attached our DPIA questionnaire (Acme_DPIA_questionnaire.xlsx) with specific fields highlighted. Can you provide an evidence packet (policy statements, retention table, and a sample audit export) by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,
Paula Gomez
Director, Data Privacy & Security
Acme Health

[Attachment: Acme_DPIA_questionnaire.xlsx]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Paula Gomez <paula.gomez@acme-health.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions re: prompt retention and training (Acme DPIA questionnaire)

Hi Paula —

Thanks for the detailed list and for sending the questionnaire. We're happy to provide an evidence package. Quick answers up front and then we'll assemble the artifacts you requested:

- Short answer on training: Redwood does not use customer prompts/responses to train or update public/shared models by default. Any model training that incorporates customer data requires explicit contractual approval and a controlled intake process.
- Opt-out/exclusion: We can add an exclusion clause to the DPA; I'll loop Legal. Operationally, we can flag your account to prevent data entering any training pipelines.
- Retention: Default hosted prompt/response logs are retained for 30 days for debugging/analytics; longer retention (up to 13 months) is available for customers on Dedicated or with add-on retention packages.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support BAAs for enterprise customers on a private or dedicated deployment.

I'll pull together:
- A concise Training Exclusion Statement (for contractual use)
- Our data retention and encryption summary (PDF)
- A small sample of audit-export CSV showing retention metadata
- SCCs/BAA references where applicable

Rishi, Marissa — can you review the highlighted items in the attached questionnaire and confirm any gaps? Paula — is EOD Wednesday (11/11) still the target?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: referenced: Acme_DPIA_questionnaire.xlsx]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions re: prompt retention and training (draft language)

Laura —

Draft language you can include in the packet (legal has reviewed high-level):

"Redwood Inference does not use customer-provided prompts, responses, or other customer data for model training, tuning, or downstream model updates unless a customer enters a specific training data agreement or explicit opt-in amendment to the DPA. For customers who opt into training, data ingestion occurs in a segregated, auditable pipeline with pseudonymization and access controls enforced; raw prompt/response pairs are not shared outside the controlled team and are retained only for the period required for the training project."

Operational notes: we'll need Security to sign off on the pseudonymization description if they want more details. Attaching a short draft statement for your packet.

-Rishi

[Attachment: training-exclusion-statement-draft.docx]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions re: prompt retention and training (ops details)

Adding operational specifics for the evidence packet — please feel free to copy these into the PDF:

- Hosted (default): prompt/response logs retained 30 days, stored encrypted at rest with customer-tenant separation; keys managed by Redwood KMS. Access is role-based and logged.
- Dedicated/Private: retention configurable; customers may elect to have logs retained 0/7/30/90/365 days. For Dedicated we'll document the configured retention per account.
- Deletion: we support bulk deletion requests via Support portal; full deletion (from hot + warm stores) completes within 14 days, and purging from backups occurs per backup retention schedule (up to 90 days). We provide deletion confirmation receipts when requested.
- HIPAA/BAA: BAA-supported for Dedicated/private deployments. Hosted customers can be covered with additional contractual controls and a BAA after a security review.
- Audit export: we can provide a CSV sample that shows record id, tenant id, timestamp, retention TTL, encryption-key-id.

I'll attach a sample CSV and the retention PDF excerpt.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: prompt-logs-retention-csv-sample.csv][Attachment: redwood-data-retention-2026.pdf]

Subject: Re: Questions re: prompt retention and training (Acme DPIA questionnaire)

Hi Paula —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is the evidence packet we put together in response to the highlighted fields in your DPIA questionnaire:

Attachments included:
- redwood-data-retention-2026.pdf — concise retention and encryption statement (includes retention table for hosted vs dedicated/private)
- training-exclusion-statement-final.pdf — final wording you can include in your DPA amendment (we can send DocuSign template if you'd like)
- prompt-logs-retention-csv-sample.csv — small audit export demonstrating retention metadata
- SCCs-Annex-2026.pdf — link to our SCC annex and instructions for execution

Key responses (summary):
1) Training: Redwood does not train on customer prompts/responses unless there is explicit, written customer consent (DPA amendment). We are prepared to add explicit exclusion language to your DPA now.
2) Exclusion process: We will work with Legal to add the clause to the DPA. Operationally, once the exclusion is in place we mark the tenant and prevent data from being routed into any training pipeline (expected SLA: 5 business days for account tagging + preventative controls to be enforced).
3) Retention & storage: Default hosted retention 30 days; encryption at rest using KMS; access is strictly RBAC and logged. For HIPAA customers we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment and a BAA.
4) HIPAA/BAA: We can provide a BAA; please confirm the Acme contact who will sign or we can connect Acme's procurement/legal team to our Legal.

Shared evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Acme_evidence_20261108
DocuSign (DPA amendment template): https://docusign.com/REDWOOD_DPA_AMENDMENT/XYZ123

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call this week with Security and Legal to walk through the packet and close any residual items.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
